keywords: EIP-8182 私密转账进入 Review
EIP-2780 交易内在 gas 重构
summary: EIPs 仓库集中合并一批新提案：私密 ETH 与 ERC-20 转账的 EIP-8182 移至 Review，结合 EIP-7851 与 EIP-8058 思路的 SETCODEFROM 代码复用指令（EIP-8298）、后量子 keystore（EIP-8310）、calldata 底价升至 96（EIP-8311）和两种状态分层方案（EIP-8295、EIP-8296）均合并。rakita 提交 EIP-2780 修改，把所有依赖状态的收费移到运行期。EF 博客发布面向机构的文章，Ethereum Institutional 当天上线。

items.title: EIP-2780：把依赖状态的收费移到运行期（冷访问附加费、新账户状态 gas）
items.note: （rakita）提交。内在 gas 只保留把交易打包进区块所需的最低成本：账户访问拆为内在阶段的 `WARM_ACCESS` 底价加运行期冷访问附加费，创建交易的新账户状态 gas 改为在运行期按条件收取。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: move state-dependent charges to runtime (cold surcharge, new-account state gas)
items.note_en: (rakita), submitted. Intrinsic gas keeps only the bare minimum needed to include a transaction in a block: account access is split into an intrinsic `WARM_ACCESS` floor plus a runtime cold surcharge, and the create transaction's new-account state gas is charged conditionally at runtime.

items.title: 新 EIP：calldata 底价升至 96
items.note: （misilva73）合并，即 EIP-8311，把 calldata 底价从每字节 64/64 提高到 96/96 gas；EIP-8311：澄清 TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN 调整范围 提交并合并。
items.title_en: New EIP: Increase Calldata Floor Cost to 96
items.note_en: (misilva73), merged as EIP-8311, raising the calldata floor from 64/64 to 96/96 gas per byte; EIP-8311: clarify the scope of the TOTAL_COST_FLOOR_PER_TOKEN change, submitted and merged.

items.title: EIP-7997：删除工厂合约 nonce 的规定
items.note: （fjl）提交，理由是工厂每次使用 nonce 都会增加，规定其 nonce 必须为 1 没有意义。
items.title_en: EIP-7997: remove specification of nonce
items.note_en: (fjl), submitted, since the factory's nonce increases on every use and requiring it to be 1 makes no sense.

items.title: 新 EIP：有状态密钥的后量子 keystore
items.note: （ch4r10t33r）合并，即 EIP-8310，扩展 EIP-2335，让加密秘密可以是 lean 共识层使用的 XMSS 种子，并加入可消耗密钥所需的机制。
items.title_en: New EIP: Post-Quantum Keystore for Stateful Keys
items.note_en: (ch4r10t33r), merged as EIP-8310. It extends EIP-2335 so the encrypted secret can be an XMSS seed as used by the lean consensus layer, and adds the machinery a consumable key needs.

keywords_en: EIP-8182 private transfers move to Review
summary_en: The EIPs repo merged a batch of new proposals: EIP-8182 for private ETH and ERC-20 transfers moved to Review, and the SETCODEFROM code reuse instruction (EIP-8298), which combines ideas from EIP-7851 and EIP-8058, the post-quantum keystore (EIP-8310), the calldata floor increase to 96 (EIP-8311) and two state tiering designs (EIP-8295, EIP-8296) were all merged. rakita submitted an EIP-2780 change moving every state-dependent charge to runtime. The EF blog published a post for institutions, and Ethereum Institutional launched the same day.
